headline: DoorDash's Nov 21 outage has no stated cause; a hack is only social-media speculation.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (1 Tier 1 not readable by us, 3 Tier 2, 2 Tier 3), 11 claims (1 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 1 Unverified, 5 Not established), 5 questions. The status page, Men's Journal and IsDown agree on the 11:30 Drive incident and 11:50 recovery. status.doordash.com could not be opened by our fetch and Men's Journal returned an access block, so their content was read through the IsDown mirror and search-result text; both are marked blocked. The hack claim is Unverified: only a social-media question quoted by Hindustan Times. No cause, post-incident report, resolution time or user count found. Outlets disagree on the Downdetector figure and start time; both are noted. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
